name: Industrial
victoryScreenHeader: Start monopolization and monopolize the world!
victoryString: You have achieved victory through the awesome power of your Industry. Your civilization's greatness - the magnificence of its factories and the power of its engineers - have astounded the world! Engineers will honor you as long as beauty brings gladness to a weary heart.
defeatString: You have been defeated. Your civilization has been overwhelmed by its many foes. But your people do not despair, for they know that one day you shall return - and lead them forward to victory!
